intro_q: You are preparing to join a semester-long academic exchange program abroad and are feeling uncertain about what to expect. Your friend Maya completed a similar program last year. Write an email to Maya asking for her advice.
bullet1_q: Explain why you decided to apply for the exchange program.
bullet2_q: Ask Maya for her recommendations on making the most of the experience.
bullet3_q: Describe what you are most hoping to gain and what you most want to avoid.
